faq.question: What exactly do I get when I buy a tier?
faq.answer: Each paid tier ships a separate downloadable artifact: Design ships a Figma file, Code ships a git bundle of the templates, Infra ships the Pulumi + Terraform catalog. All artifacts include lifetime upgrades for the major version you bought.

faq.question: Is this a subscription?
faq.answer: No. Every paid tier is a one-time purchase. Major-version upgrades are included; if we ship PlatformKit 2.0 and you bought 1.x, you get 2.0 in your portal.

faq.question: How does the license work?
faq.answer: Per-organization license, internal use, unlimited seats unless the comparison matrix says otherwise. You can ship the resulting product to your customers; you cannot resell the templates themselves.

faq.question: What's the refund policy?
faq.answer: 30-day money-back guarantee on every paid tier. Open a ticket and we refund the original payment instrument; we do not require a reason.

faq.question: When should I pick Enterprise?
faq.answer: When you need a signed DPA, named engineering support, or private commercial modules that are not on the public catalog. We schedule a 30-minute discovery call and quote.

faq.question: Can I run the platform on Community alone?
faq.answer: Yes. Community is the complete public nine-module starter and extension contract. Product-specific capabilities, delivery providers, and end-user experiences are built downstream; paid offerings are separate accelerators, not hidden OSS modules.
